description: Source code for the TSL2540 ambient light sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, configuration, data fetching, and attribute setting functions.

methods.name: tsl2540_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches ambient light and IR data from the sensor via I2C.

methods.name: tsl2540_channel_get
methods.description: Calculates and returns sensor values for light and IR channels.

methods.name: tsl2540_attr_set
methods.description: Sets various sensor attributes such as thresholds, gain, integration time, and modes.

methods.name: tsl2540_setup
methods.description: Initial configuration of the sensor, including gain and integration time.

methods.name: tsl2540_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, configures I2C, and sets default parameters.

methods.name: tsl2540_pm_action
methods.description: Handles power management actions for suspend and resume.
